english: Not Zura. Katsura. ...But right now, Zurako.
No, nothing. Just get going, Zura.
What a pain! You said it yourself!
Hey. Seeing a lot of you today.
Katsura? Don't know any wig of a guy like that.
Caught a guy trying to sell Gin Tama to Joi rebels.
Be grateful. I'll give you a discount.
Sounds fun. Got Gin Tama to spare!
Huh? Me? Are you talking about ME?!
...Am I small fry? Am I, old man?
Shut up! Out of the way!
Who'd pay you?! Forget that small fry!
All this arguing... We're getting nowhere.
What did you expect? All that trouble in the club? I'd fire me too.
What? Want to get fired from HERE? Anytime.
Who's worried about wigs? I've got plenty of hair!
No. Rather think about nothing than worry about them.
Well, uh... Right! Money's made to go round...
Got it! This, Shinpachi! THIS was bothering me!
What's been bugging me all along... Is the overdue rent!
Quiet, Shinpachi! My stomach can't take it!
Feels like we're almost there already...
Wait, Gin! Might as well ask Otose to feed us!
Blew a perfectly good job! How'll you pay rent?!
Ahh... Thought food was sorted for a while...
It's all yeah, yeah, yeah! King of Planet Yeah, are you?!
Defiant again... Oh, right! Speaking of getting fired...
Katsura, then? He said Gin Tama weren't just toys...
Hmm... What could it be, then?
...No, Kagura. That's WHY it's a problem...
Might've won if you fought with me...
Not doing it to help YOU.
Then, much as I hate it, a joint battle!
Can't help it... Just this once.
Hah! Your attacks couldn't prop up a fart!
Doesn't matter. Just a gadget maker.
Right, then... I was born... years ago...
Of course! Important to understanding me today!
Oh, fine. Won't tell you, then.
...Well, I'd better go. Work tonight too.
Oh, you're right. An illusion, maybe?
Well, really going now. See ya.
Been attacking Gin Tama owners since last night.
A reason? Nonsense! Broke and went berserk!
I think... Some wanted gadget maker caused trouble...
W-what?! Don't shout all of a sudden!
What is it? Now I'm curious.
Hold it! Why hear your life story?!
You... Did that on purpose to let him escape...?!
Can't believe it... Saburo had such a kind heart...
Wait... He attacked people with Gin Tama?
Saburo knew I was troubled about Dragon Tama...?
...Well, time to go home and fix Saburo.
Thank goodness! Otae's safe! What a relief!
Please! Let me walk you home!
Kondo's hurt too... I'll go with them, Hijikata.
Now, now. Let's say you both beat it.
The Shinsengumi and Gin saved me.
No, thanks. I can go alone.
Now talk. What are you planning? Why Gin Tama?
Sorry, Gintoki! Still... I still can't tell you...
Say what you like. Can't tell you yet.
But believe this one thing, Gintoki.
Before I go... One question, Zura.
You're sure this isn't... anything shady?
...Then why do shady deals with this idiot?
Fine! What a pain! I'll pretend I saw nothing.
Business done? Then come on, idiot prince. Let's leave.
Hmph. Can't stand this wighead... But he's never been able to lie.
That's greed for you! Already rich, too!
Tch! If you're playing hero, say so first!
...Tch. Hey, idiot prince. Stay a little longer.
Letting the big fish go. Least we can give them a consolation prize.
Back to the room! Got it, you two?
Came to sell Gin Tama. What a disaster!
If I could, there'd be no trouble!
W-why?! You just told me to leave...
Big fish? Escape? Prize? What are you saying?
Prince, quiet. This is the good part!
...Everything I do is for this country!
